## Application Security  
### Development Security (Secure SDLC)  
**Code Review:**
- Peer review required before deployment
- Security-focused code review checklist
- Authorization controls review
- SQL injection/XSS prevention checks  
**Testing:**
- Unit testing (developers)
- Integration testing (QA)
- Security testing (penetration tests, vulnerability scans)
- Load testing (before production release)  
**Deployment:**
- Automated deployment (no manual prod changes)
- Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)
- Rollback plan documented
- Production monitoring enabled

raw_entities.name: Application Security Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy governing the security requirements for application development, testing, and deployment within FirstUK Bank. It focuses on the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to ensure code integrity and system resilience.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Peer Code Review
raw_entities.description: Requires that all code undergo a peer review process prior to being deployed. This is a mandatory gate in the development lifecycle.

raw_entities.name: Security-Focused Code Review Standards
raw_entities.description: Mandates the use of a security-focused checklist during code reviews, specifically targeting authorization controls and the prevention of SQL injection and XSS.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Stage Testing Requirement
raw_entities.description: Obligates the performance of unit testing by developers, integration testing by QA, and load testing prior to any production release.

raw_entities.name: Security Testing Mandate
raw_entities.description: Requires the execution of security-specific testing, including penetration tests and vulnerability scans, as part of the SDLC.

raw_entities.name: Automated Deployment Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates the use of automated deployment processes and explicitly prohibits manual changes to the production environment.

raw_entities.name: Production Change Approval Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires that all changes to the production environment be approved by the Change Advisory Board.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)

raw_entities.name: Deployment Rollback and Monitoring Obligation
raw_entities.description: Requires that a documented rollback plan be in place and that production monitoring be enabled for all deployments.

raw_entities.name: SQL Injection
raw_entities.description: A specific technical vulnerability where malicious SQL statements are inserted into entry fields for execution, which the policy seeks to prevent via code review.

raw_entities.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
raw_entities.description: A security vulnerability involving the injection of malicious scripts into trusted websites, addressed through mandatory code review checks.

raw_entities.name: Penetration Testing
raw_entities.description: An operational security safeguard used to identify vulnerabilities by simulating attacks against the application.

raw_entities.name: Vulnerability Scanning
raw_entities.description: An automated tool used to detect known security weaknesses within the application environment.

raw_entities.name: Change Advisory Board Approval
raw_entities.description: A governance gate requiring formal approval before any changes are promoted to the production environment.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)

raw_entities.name: Production Monitoring
raw_entities.description: The implementation of monitoring tools to ensure the stability and security of the application after deployment.

raw_entities.name: Developers
raw_entities.description: Staff responsible for the creation of code and the execution of unit testing.

raw_entities.name: Quality Assurance (QA)
raw_entities.description: Staff collective responsible for performing integration testing on the application.

raw_entities.name: Change Advisory Board
raw_entities.description: A governing body with the authority to approve or reject changes to the production environment.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)
